entries.title: Brighter Backgrounds & Home Title Polish
items: Lightened the global page background treatment so Apps, Games, Settings, Chat, Friends, and other tabs no longer get the heavy black wash.
Matched the clearer background treatment more closely to the Donate page.
Removed the black drop/fade shadow from the Lunar Proxy home title.
Refreshed Lunar stylesheet cache versions so the visual fix appears immediately.

entries.title: Friends & Chat Avatar Layout Fix
items: Fixed Friends sidebar/profile layout so profile pictures stay in their own column and names and usernames no longer overlap them.
Added stronger text wrapping and ellipsis handling for narrow Friends layouts.
Fixed the Friends profile header so its text stays inside the profile area instead of bleeding into the message list.
Matched Global Chat profile pictures to the Friends chat avatar treatment with consistent circular sizing, clipping, and image positioning.

entries.title: Friends, Reactions & Access Fix
items: Restored existing Friends relationships when older saved friendship data uses legacy formats or accepted requests.
Fixed emoji reactions being rejected as unavailable by allowing the full emoji picker instead of only the original reaction set.
Kept sticker reactions supported for both Global Chat and Friends.
Raised the logged-out registration prompt above Lunar backgrounds, cursor effects, and other visual layers so it is visible and clickable.
Updated script cache versions so the fixes load immediately.

entries.title: Chat Tools & Lunar Access Gate
items: Moved GIFs, Emoji, and Stickers into a single + menu in Global Chat and Friends.
Repositioned the GIF and Emoji/Sticker panels around the new + button.
Fixed the Emoji panel so clicks inside it no longer close it unexpectedly.
Added a blurred glass registration prompt for visitors who are not logged in.
Added Register and Log In return flows so authentication sends you back to the page you opened.

entries.title: Friends Glass & Layout Polish
items: Added a subtle glass surface across the Friends page and its panels.
Added a small gap below the top navigation so the Friends frame no longer touches it.
Tightened spacing across the sidebar, profile, messages, and composer.
Kept buttons lightly glassy with stronger contrast for important actions.

entries.title: Chat & Friends Stability Update
items: Added shared message deletion with a visible Message deleted state.
Added Shift + left-click deletion for your own messages.
Unified sticker reactions with emoji reactions.
Improved sticker sizing, bookmarks, avatars, and reaction controls.
Fixed Friends chat layout and viewport sizing.
Improved picker and navigation behavior across Global Chat and Friends.

entries.title: Emoji & Sticker Collection
items: Added full emoji browsing with search and recently used emojis.
Added sticker creation and upload directly into your collection.
Added sticker reaction support for Global Chat and Friends.
Added hover-only sticker collection bookmarks.

entries.title: Lunar Glass UI
items: Expanded the glass interface styling across chat surfaces.
Improved theme customization and cursor persistence.
Added richer picker, reaction, and profile surfaces.
